Welcome to Sunya IAS. 

In this session we will cover important Judgements that are highly relevant for UPSC Mains 2027. The session focuses on key schemes, flagship programmes, reports, facts, data, and value addition that can help improve your answers in GS Mains papers.

This video is a part of Brahmastra 2027 - 

Brahmastra program covers the four main components, and each of these component will address the problems faced by students, where-our program acts as the one stop solution.

Key components of Brahmastra:
Component 1: Integrated Prelims & Mains Test Series
                   - 35 Mains Tests (20 Subject-wise + 15 Full-Length)
                   - 45 Prelims Tests (Part-Length, Revision & Full-Length)
Component  2: Study Material
                   -  Mains GS Books & Content Boosters
                   -  Prelims Static Revision Notes & Current Affairs Notes
                   -  Concise, Exam-Oriented Study Material
Component 3: Personalized Mentorship
                    - Dedicated Personal Mentor
                    - Study Planning, Doubt Resolution & Source Guidance
                    - Answer Writing, Essay, Ethics & Value Addition Sessions
Component 4: Daily Targets
                    - Structured Daily Study Plan
                     - Book-Wise Reading Targets to Ensure Consistent Progress
